name: @steuererklaerung/eric
author: Pascal Garber
description: ERiC (ELSTER Rich Client) binding for Node (koffi) and GJS (native gi:// typelib). The ERiC native library is user-provided via ERIC_HOME and is NEVER bundled or published — see README.

scripts.init:meson: meson setup build . -Deric_lib_dir="${ERIC_HOME:?set ERIC_HOME to your ERiC install}/lib"
scripts.build:meson: npm run init:meson && meson compile -C build && npm run copy:prebuilds
scripts.copy:prebuilds: mkdir -p prebuilds/linux-x86_64 && cp build/libsteuereric.so build/SteuerEric-1.0.gir build/SteuerEric-1.0.typelib prebuilds/linux-x86_64/
